authoredFrom: Input (built in tests/storage/producer-loss.test.ts from encoding-failed.json, seed et005b-encoding-failed): simulation.started at 10 ms (eventSeq 1); a job without cargo.loaded or market at 20 ms (2); a toll of 5 at 30 ms (3); one record the contract rejects at 40 ms (4, the simulator's encodingFailure step); a toll at 50 ms (5); job.delivered at 60 ms (6); the clear at 70 ms (7). No frame step, so no snapshot and a checkpoint without a job. One durable connection from 0 to 100 ms that commits and acknowledges each item, recorded through the production wiring (recording-runtime.ts) into synthetic:<name>.

Producer (protocol v1 §9 and the D7 bound table; docs/native-transport-v1.md, Encoder; encoding-failed.expected.json): a record that cannot be encoded becomes gap coverage at its stream position with cause encodingFailed and its occurrence time as both lost times, so the connection carries events 1-3, the gap [4, 4] (encodingFailed 1, lost at 1,000,040,000,000 ns) and events 5-7. Each item is acknowledged after its commit: ACKs 1-7.

docs/trips.md, load state (T12): the job (2) is configured after the first simulation.started, while running, so trip@2 opens `unknown` with no cause interval, no truck or trailer reference and the unknown game mode; the toll (3) is attributed `trip` (T14).

docs/trips.md, 'any open | gap with a new suffix' (T10) and trip-reducer case 8: the gap [4, 4] closes trip@2 {none, gap, partial} at the session's last label, the toll 3 (1,800,000,000,030; a gap carries no UTC, T15), with one event-loss interval (an encoding failure is not a consumer absence; trip-reducer T10 table) of its suffix [4, 4], the lost times as monotonic bounds on the capture clock and detail {cause: gap, the six counters, the record's range, redelivered: false}. The job becomes untracked.

docs/trips.md, Attribution (T14): the toll 5 while the job is untracked is `ambiguous`; job.delivered (6) is the outcome of an untracked job, `ambiguous`, and closes no trip; it ends the untracked job. The clear (7) adds nothing. Without the loss the trip would have closed complete at the delivery (T13).

Journal (docs/journal.md and docs/storage.md, Window rule J7): the list row is outcome none, close reason gap, partial; its timeline window runs from the job configuration (2) through 3, just before the first eventSeq the gap newly covered (`close-gap`), and its intervals page holds the event-loss interval.

Counts: 7 first commits (6 events, 1 gap). Losses (G6): lostEvents 1, eventLoss 1. The recording status carries those losses and the idle trip summary (phase idle, no completeness, no untracked job); it reads `waiting` throughout, because no frame publishes a state with an available simulation (docs/telemetry-service-v1.md, Freshness; G3 rule 8).
